primaryImage.sourcePassage: She wrote Washington to look for her and Col. Sellers toward the end of November; and at about the time set the two travelers arrived safe in the capital of the nation, sure enough.
primaryImage.sceneAnchor: She wrote Washington to look for her and Col. Sellers toward the end of November; and at about the time set the two travelers arrived safe in the capital of the nation, sure enough.
primaryImage.visualDescriptionEn: Small nineteenth-century printed illustration of a steam locomotive pulling several railway carriages through countryside, viewed from the side; no passengers identifiable.
primaryImage.altEn: An original nineteenth-century railway tailpiece at the end of Chapter XXX, where Laura and Colonel Sellers travel by train to Washington.
primaryImage.altAr: رسمة تاريخية أصلية لقطار بخاري يجر عربات وسط الريف، وُضعت في ختام الفصل الثلاثين الذي يروي سفر لورا والكولونيل سيلرز بالقطار إلى واشنطن.
